issues.detail: The Greek 'βεβηλους' (bebelous) refers to 'babyish' or 'infantile' things, not 'phàm tục' (vulgar/profane). The Vietnamese translation changes the nature of the adjective.
The Vietnamese adds 'như chuyện các bà già' (like stories of old women), which has no basis in the Greek text. The Greek simply says 'babyish and grotesque myths'.
